text:
Alex (Sales): Quick transition snapshot for Asteria Health — signed yesterday. Key asks: private VPC, SSO (Okta), 24/7 Dedicated next-quarter, and a short enablement for their ML infra team. Renewal timeline: annual, next review in 11 months (flagged for risk if onboarding slips).
Jamie (CS): Thanks Alex. Copying next steps below. I'll own onboarding and enablement.
Morgan (Support): I'll take first-line support + runbook handoff. Need the SSO metadata and certs.
Diego (Eng): I'll own the private deployment checklist and QA for the dedicated pool. ETA to produce infra plan: EOD Wed.
Alex (Sales): Notes from contract: 6-month ramp with two checkpoints (30/90 days). They requested the ability to burst to hosted if dedicated hits capacity. Put that in the SLA appendix.
Jamie (CS): Owner assignments: Onboarding: Jamie. Provisioning/infra: Diego. Support triage: Morgan. Renewal owner: Alex (Sales). I'll create the onboarding playbook and a 30-day success metric doc.
Jamie (CS): Action items — please react with :thumbsup: when you have ownership confirmed.
Diego (Eng): :thumbsup: I need the model size and expected QPS. Alex, can you drop the P95 token budget and current prompt sizes?
Alex (Sales): Dropping specs: model: open-llama-13b, expected steady QPS ~12, peak bursts ~60 for 45s, median prompt length ~350 tokens, p95 latency goal <1200ms.
Morgan (Support): Got it. I'll start a support runbook template and link to our incident templates. Also opening a ticket: SR-45782 for SSO/PROVISION tracking.
Jamie (CS): Scheduling enablement: propose Wed 2pm PT for a 60m session (ops + ML infra). Alex, confirm Asteria attendees.
Alex (Sales): Confirmed: CTO (Lina), Infra lead (Ravi), and Security (Marta).
Diego (Eng): For private deploy, I'll need: VPC CIDR, egress rules, KMS ARN (if using envelope), and SSH bastion details. Example snippet for the infra team to fill out:
```
VPC_CIDR=10.72.0.0/16
ALLOWED_EGRESS=[accounts.redwood-inference.com:443, logs.redwood-inference.com:443]
KMS_ARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
```
Jamie (CS): I'll create a short questionnaire and send to Asteria to collect those values. Also adding a risk tag: RISK-ONBOARD-DELAY if provisioning > 7 days.
OncallBot: Incident template assigned -> SR-45782 linked to thread 1719456789.
Morgan (Support): Quick note on renewal risk: if we miss the 30-day check-in or they hit >30% throttling, flag renewal outreach immediately. I'll add monitoring alerts for burst errors and quota drops.
Jamie (CS): Feedback capture plan: we'll run two enablement surveys (post 2w and post 8w), and include a short eval harness for quality regressions tied to their top 10 prompts. Diego, can you provide an eval export hook?
Diego (Eng): Yes — will add a webhook endpoint and a small script. Example endpoint: https://internal-hooks.redwood/asteria-evals. I'll post the script in the onboarding doc.
Alex (Sales): Anything blocking kick-off?
Jamie (CS): Blockers: waiting on SSO metadata + VPC details. If we get those by EOD Tue we can meet the 30-day checkpoint.
Alex (Sales): I'll ping their Infra (Ravi) now and post his reply here.
Morgan (Support): Adding a support milestone checklist: initial triage, runbook shared, alerting enabled, 24/7 escalation tested. I'll mark owners once Diego's infra plan is in.
Jamie (CS): Great — I'll create the internal transfer doc in our drive and share the link here. For transparency: owners and deadlines will be added as action items.
Alex (Sales): Thanks team — huge priority. I'll update the customer-facing onboarding timeline and loop Lina in after the enablement invite is sent. :rocket:
